function.name: move_to
function.description: Move the robot arm end-effector (grasp site) to an absolute target position [x, y, z] in meters.

x.description: X coordinate in meters (lateral position, reachable range: -0.30 to 0.30).

y.description: Y coordinate in meters (forward reach, reachable range: -0.35 to -0.05).

z.description: Z coordinate in meters (height above table, reachable range: 0.00 to 0.35).

function.name: pick
function.description: Pick up the red cube from the table using the autonomous side-approach grasp strategy. No coordinates required.

function.name: place
function.description: Place the currently held object onto the table or pad at target position [x, y, z] in meters and release gripper.

x.description: X coordinate in meters (right pad is +0.15, left pad is -0.15).

y.description: Y coordinate in meters (pads are at -0.18).

z.description: Z coordinate in meters (pad surface height is 0.015).

function.name: gripper
function.description: Set the robot arm gripper openness directly. 0.0 is fully open, 1.0 is fully closed.

value.description: Gripper openness ratio from 0.0 (fully open) to 1.0 (fully closed).

function.name: state
function.description: Query the live simulation telemetry: returns end-effector position, cube position, distance to cube, whether the cube is held, gripper status, and joint angles.

function.name: camera
function.description: Capture an image snapshot from the wrist-mounted camera. Returns the filesystem path to the saved PNG image.

function.name: reset_home
function.description: Return the robot arm to its default home resting position.

function.name: scenario
function.description: Execute a pre-programmed pick-and-place or inspection scenario by name ('A', 'B', or 'C'). A: Pick and place to right pad (+0.15, -0.18, 0.015) then home. B: Pick and place to left pad (-0.15, -0.18, 0.015) then home. C: Inspection wave with camera photo.

name.description: Scenario name: 'A' (place right), 'B' (place left), or 'C' (inspection wave).

function.name: collisions
function.description: Query currently detected physical contact pairs between robot parts, table, and cube. Useful to check if the arm hit something or is touching an object.
